review.review_kind: Independent complete final source/audit and recorded-evidence read; no reviewer Lean build
source_scope: All quantified formula/proof codes are elements of the arbitrary IΣ1 arithmetic model; the matrix arities are the fixed external constants1 and2. No object model of ZF/ZFC is assumed.

SchemaRecognizer witnesses are literal: closure countm=0, body itself as closed witness, empty free-variable substitution, typed bound-variable wellformedness, explicit shiftfixedness and actual constructor bound. This does not invert only standard quotations.

Separation and Replacement core substitutions are raw identities at the appropriate fixed arities. The generic upstream subst_eq_self is used; a Nat-specialized convenience lemma is not misapplied to nonstandard codes.
Quoted fixed atoms have the actual arities3/3/4 in the Replacement shift proof. Explicit quoted-atom shift equalities and K.shift=K propagate through the literal bodies.
Membership is in the actual existing ZF/ZFC Δ1Class using direct union and SepR/RepR recognition, rather than a new predicate with assumed equivalence.

The four proof carriers use literal byAxm. The raw helper reconstructs the actual DerivationOf proof and its singleton conclusion, avoiding conflation of the original theory recognizer with a re-internalized theory typeclass.
The audit retains explicit arbitrary code:V inputs and explicit proof:V witnesses, actual ZF and ZFC Proof conclusions, and simple truth-body controls.
Shiftfixedness remains a hypothesis. Arbitrary freeparameter schema closure, relativization, internal source-proof translation and a C254/ZFC consistency comparison are not supplied.

Fresh source checks cover two pinned Foundation SetTheory.Basic files, five existing project prerequisites and the new module. The two external files were built only in scratch under the parent-authorized narrow exception; no checkout/object tree was changed.

Seven named cached boundary providers were rehashed. The namespace mirror exposes other cached dependency objects without independently attesting the entire dependency cache; the evidence states this limit. No whole Foundation/Mathlib rebuild or reviewer Lean run is claimed.

Development failures are retained. Final fixes normalize typed/raw interfaces, atom arities, formula union evaluation and the direct raw axiom carrier; no theorem statement or explicit shiftfixed premise is weakened.

review.review_kind: Independent complete portable guard read and exact-byte/provenance check; no Lean build
scope_notes: The entire final portable guard was read. Frozen newsource/audit hashes and exact11-probe/10-caller names/count are enforced; Python-O is explicitly rejected using require, not an optimized-away assertion.

Fresh source checking is exactly the two pinned Foundation SetTheory.Basic files and six project modules (five prerequisites plus newmodule), in dependency order; no prebuilt object for these eight units is trusted instead.

Project sources are read from the supplied currentrepo; the final source/audit can be explicitly relocated but must retain frozen bytes. Compiler/dependency discovery uses pinned4.32 and clean pinned Foundation/Mathlib.

Fresh outputs are external and empty before writes. The namespace mirror creates writable directories only along the two designated Foundation module paths; untouched branches are links, so compiled outputs cannot write through a linked targetmodule path.

Seven named cached dependency boundary providers are captured and checked at their actual first selected object both before and after. The input hashes include source/audit snapshots, compiler, helper, manifest, freshsources and namedprovider source/objects.

Every fresh object is hashed immediately after its own compilation and rechecked after all later modules and the audit. Successful reports allow only propext,Classical.choice,Quot.sound and reject sorry.
Named boundary identities and namespace mirrors are not a source verification or historical hash binding of the entire transitive dependency cache. This limit is explicit in both guard and metadata.

A fresh maintainedlocal proof check permits changed maintained prerequisites and captures their current bytes; it does not assert those prerequisites remain the historicalrun4 bytes unless the outputrecord hashes also match. The reviewed currentpreflight does match.

Portable prepare-only executes no Lean source/audit check and has no freshobjects. dependency_build=True describes the planned narrowcheck, not a proof that the two external units were rebuilt during prepare-only.
The original kernel record is run4PASS; both portable records are PREPARED_NOT_BUILT. No independent reviewer build or blanket wholedependencyattestation is inferred.
